items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the hyperbolic sine of a value that is measured in ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS.
items.translation: 创建一个新AggregationExpression，用于计算以ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS为单位的值的双曲正弦。

items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the hyperbolic sine of a value that is measured in the given unit.
items.translation: 创建一个新AggregationExpression，用于计算给定unit（单位）中值的反双曲正弦。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the sine of a numeric value given in radians.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AggregationExpression，用于计算给定 radians 数值的正弦值。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the sine of a numeric value.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算数值值的正弦值。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。
